parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description:
The sorting order of event records in the response. Valid values:

- **0** (default): descending order.
- **1**: ascending order.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the default value **0** is used and event records are sorted in descending order.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name to query.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the event records to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1516541900303.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The event type to query. Valid values:

- **info**: information.

- **alert**: alerting.

- **error**: error.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description:
The identifier of the event to query. You can view the event **Identifier** in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) to view the identifier in the returned TSL information.

> If the event **PowerOff** belongs to a custom (non-default) module **testFb**, set this parameter to **testFb:PowerOff**.

If you do not specify this parameter, all event data of the default module and custom modules is queried.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
><notice> The **IotId** parameter is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the event records to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1516538300303.
